format.description: The version of this file format. Always 1.

id.description: A name for this figure, like "hero". It matches the file name.

tile.description: How many pixels of the picture make one tile of the game, in pixels.

w.description: How wide one pose is, in pixels.

h.description: How tall one pose is, in pixels.

frame.description: The size of one pose, in pixels.

outline.description: An edge one pixel wide round the whole figure, as # and six digits, like #111314. Left out means no edge.

id.description: A name for this colour, for what it is for, like "body", "trim" or "ink".

color.description: The colour, as # and six digits, like #f37f94.

paints.description: The colours the parts use, each named for what it is for.

id.description: A name for this part, used once in this figure, like "head".

shape.description: "block" is a rectangle; "round" is an ellipse that fills the same box.

x.description: Where the part's middle is, in pixels from the left edge of the frame.

y.description: Where the part's middle is, in pixels from the top edge of the frame.

w.description: How wide the part is, in pixels.

h.description: How tall the part is, in pixels.

paint.description: Which of the figure's paints it is drawn in, by id, like "body".

turn.description: How far it is turned clockwise about its middle, in degrees. Left out means not turned.

parts.description: The parts, drawn first to last, so the first is at the back.

id.description: A name for this pose, used once in this figure, like "idle" or "run-1".

part.description: Which part moves, by id, like "head".

dx.description: How far it moves right (left if below 0), in pixels. Left out means not at all.

dy.description: How far it moves down (up if below 0), in pixels. Left out means not at all.

turn.description: How much further it turns clockwise, in degrees, added to the part's own. Left out means none.

moves.description: The parts that move in this pose. Write [] for the figure just as its parts say.

poses.description: The ways the figure can stand. Each one is a picture in the figure's sheet.

id.description: A name for these colours, used once in this figure, like "two".
A name for this colour, for what it is for, like "body", "trim" or "ink".

color.description: The colour, as # and six digits, like #f37f94.

paints.description: Only the paints that change, each with the id it has in the figure and its new colour.

variants.description: The same figure in other colours. Player 2's hero is drawn in the first, player 3's in the second, player 4's in the third. Left out means none.

format.description: The version of this file format. Always 2 for a figure built from sliders.

id.description: A name for this figure, like "keeper". It matches the file name.

body.description: What it is built on. Always "person" for now.

tile.description: How many pixels of the picture make one tile of the game, in pixels.

w.description: How wide one pose is, in pixels.

h.description: How tall one pose is, in pixels.

frame.description: The size of one pose, in pixels.

height.description: How tall it stands, in pixels, from the ground to the top of its head.

build.description: How big its frame is, from slight to broad.

legs.description: How long the legs are, from short to long.

arms.description: How long the arms are, from short to long.

shoulders.description: How wide the shoulders are, from narrow to wide.

hips.description: How wide the hips are, from narrow to wide.

fat.description: How soft and round it is, from lean to round.

muscle.description: How thick its arms and legs are, from thin to strong.

head.description: How big the head is, from small to big.

neck.description: How thick the neck is, from thin to thick.

neckLength.description: How long the neck is, from none to long.

hands.description: How big the hands are, from small to big.

feet.description: How big the feet are, from small to big.

posture.description: How it carries itself, from slouched to proud.

hunch.description: How far the shoulders round forward, from square to hunched.

headTilt.description: How far the head leans to one side, in degrees.

age.description: How old it looks, from young to old: an older figure stoops and steps shorter.

chunk.description: How blocky it is, from life-like to chunky pixel art.

sliders.description: How the body is shaped, each from 0 to 1 except "height". A slider left out is at its normal.

eyes.description: How the eyes are drawn: dots, ovals, wide, sleepy or closed. Left out means dots.

eyeSize.description: How big the eyes are, from small to big.

eyeSpacing.description: How far apart the eyes are, from close to wide.

eyeTilt.description: How the eyes slant, from drooping at the outer corners to rising.

brows.description: How the brows are drawn: none, soft, straight, heavy or arched. Left out means soft.

browWeight.description: How thick the brows are, from thin to heavy.

mouth.description: How the mouth is drawn: none, line, smile, frown or open. Left out means line.

nose.description: How big the nose is, from none to big.

cheeks.description: How full the cheeks are, from hollow to round.

jaw.description: How wide the jaw is, from narrow to square.

face.description: The face: its styles and its numbers, each from 0 to 1. Anything left out is at its normal.

skin.description: The colour of the skin, as the id of a colour in the palette, like "tan".

hair.description: The colour of the hair, as the id of a colour in the palette. Left out means no hair is drawn.

eyes.description: The colour of the eyes, as the id of a colour in the palette. Left out means the palette's ink.

paints.description: The colours it is painted in, each the id of a colour in the palette.

palette.description: The palette its colours are named in. Left out means the framework's own.

outline.description: An edge one pixel wide round the figure: "dark" is each colour's darkest shade, "ink" is one near-black. Left out means no edge.

id.description: A name for these colours, used once in this figure, like "two".

skin.description: The skin in these colours, as the id of a colour in the palette.

hair.description: The hair in these colours, as the id of a colour in the palette.

eyes.description: The eyes in these colours, as the id of a colour in the palette.

paints.description: Only the colours that change, each as the id of a colour in the palette.

variants.description: The same figure in other colours. Player 2's figure is drawn in the first, player 3's in the second, player 4's in the third. Left out means none.
